final-capstone-file-room-handoff-termina.title: Milestone 1: Build the Archive Structure
final-capstone-file-room-handoff-termina.prompt: Open `media-archive` and inspect what arrived. Create `organized/photos`, `organized/documents`, `backup`, and `review`, then add an empty `review/needs-review.txt` marker and verify the new structure.
final-capstone-file-room-handoff-termina.hint: Preserve every incoming file while adding only the required folders and review marker.

help.concept: The capstone begins by adding structure without disturbing the incoming records.
help.hint_1: Inspect first, then create the four requested destinations.
help.hint_2: The review marker should exist but remain empty at this stage.

3.message: Create the required directories with `mkdir` or `mkdir -p`.

final-capstone-file-room-handoff-termina.title: Milestone 2: Write the Archive Guide
final-capstone-file-room-handoff-termina.prompt: With the archive folders in place, create `organized/README.txt` with these three lines in order: `Community media archive`, `Photos go in organized/photos`, and `Documents go in organized/documents`. Put `Check image names before publishing` in `review/needs-review.txt`, then read both files.
final-capstone-file-room-handoff-termina.hint: Create the first README line, preserve it while adding the next two, and verify the finished text.

help.concept: Redirection can create a file and append later lines while preserving earlier text.
help.hint_1: The README must contain exactly three guide lines in order.
help.hint_2: Read both written files before moving on.

final-capstone-file-room-handoff-termina.title: Milestone 3: Organize the Incoming Records

Put the photo index at `organized/photos/index.txt`, the release forms at `organized/documents/release-forms.txt`, and the shoot notes at `review/shoot-notes.txt`. Check the inbox and destination folders to confirm each file moved.
final-capstone-file-room-handoff-termina.hint: These are relocations, not copies; preserve each file's content at its destination.

help.concept: Moving files changes their paths while preserving their contents.
help.hint_1: The photo index is both moved and renamed.
help.hint_2: Verify the new destinations and the cleaned old paths.

final-capstone-file-room-handoff-termina.title: Milestone 5: Verify and Mark the Archive Ready

final-capstone-file-room-handoff-termina.hint: The READY marker is the final action; create it only after the archive evidence has been checked.

help.concept: A final handoff should be supported by filesystem and file content checks before it is marked ready.
help.hint_1: Verify the archive before creating READY.txt.
help.hint_2: The READY marker should contain the requested verification text.

practice-final-capstone-handoff-check.title: Practice: Clean a Small Handoff Folder
practice-final-capstone-handoff-check.prompt: A small handoff folder contains one real agenda and one confirmed temporary note. Move the agenda from the inbox into the archive, remove only the temporary note, and inspect both folders to confirm the final state.
practice-final-capstone-handoff-check.hint: Preserve the real record, delete only the explicitly temporary file, and verify the result.

help.concept: An integrated handoff can combine inspection, moving, safe single-file deletion, and final verification.
help.hint_1: The agenda should survive in the archive.
help.hint_2: The temporary note should be the only deleted file.

mv handoff-practice/inbox/agenda.txt handoff-practice/archive/agenda.txt
rm handoff-practice/inbox/tmp-note.txt
ls handoff-practice/archive handoff-practice/inbox

capstone-synopsis.title: Final Capstone: Community Media Archive
capstone-synopsis.bodyMarkdown: Use the terminal skills from Modules 1 and 2 to turn an incoming media folder into a verified handoff. The five milestones are cumulative: create the structure, write the guide, organize the incoming records, back up the index and remove only the temporary import, then verify the finished archive.
